title: turn_audio
description: Phone to hub, with the `corpus` capability: one piece of the Recording of the Turn on offer, sent only in answer to a `turn_ack` with status `send`, from the `offset` it asked for. The phone sends the next piece only after the hub's next `turn_ack`, so at most one piece is ever in flight and a live message never waits behind more than one.

offset.description: Where in the file `data` starts: the `offset` of the `turn_ack` this answers.

data.description: The bytes, standard base64 with padding. The phone picks the piece size (the app sends 32 KiB); the hub accepts any size that fits a frame (1 MiB).

last.description: Whether this piece ends the file. The hub then checks the whole file against the offer's `sha256` and `bytes`, and answers `stored` or `rejected`.
